meta.title: Construction progress monitoring by drone | DroneAtlas
meta.description: Recurring aerial records of construction sites in Israel for progress tracking, date comparison and field coordination.

title: Construction progress monitoring
lede: Recurring aerial records of the construction site, for comparison and coordination.
intro: Repeated flights over the same coverage show how a site is changing: structure, earthworks, stockpiles and work areas.
Flight frequency and the type of comparison (orthophoto, model or walkthrough) are set for each site. No sample clients or sites are listed here.
deliverables: A model or point cloud when needed
A coverage record for each flight
uses: A base for staged quantity checks

side.title: Talk about a construction site
side.text: Share the site location and how often you want it documented.
